title: Why Memory Stocks Rose While the Nasdaq Fell
description:
https://www.signumhq.com

Memory names were green while the index was red. Micron +2.02%, Western Digital +2.04%, SanDisk +1.70% — against the Nasdaq 100 at -0.61% (midday, 11:28 ET Aug 21).

Most people treat chips as one trade. We measured it. Across 660 trading days since 2024, AI chips track the index at 0.72 correlation (NVDA 0.74, AMD 0.69). Memory tracks at 0.59 (MU 0.67, WDC 0.59, STX 0.52). Memory is 17% less tied to the index — it runs its own supply cycle.

Before you chase it: this setup has happened 67 times since 2021. Five days later the memory group was higher 58% of the time, against 56% on any given day. That is a coin flip.
